summary: Inventory Control and Quality Assurance analytics for a fulfillment center, including the Sarbanes-Oxley controls behind inventory accuracy.
bullets: Owned the SOX-compliance IRDR workflow: personally researched 1,000+ inventory discrepancies and built the data systems and reporting that satisfied Sarbanes-Oxley audit requirements.
Built SQL and Excel reporting for inventory accuracy and defect visibility; delivered dashboards, recurring leadership reports and a network-wide quality recap deck.
Shipped an autonomous root-cause agent that plans, gathers evidence and writes complete IRDRs, collapsing hours of research per defect into seconds.
